newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan health workers plan to renew strike.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan health workers plan to renew strike.

text.p: A Moroccan health workers union said its members' two-day strike ending on Thursday had been strongly supported and would be renewed next week as their demands had not been met.

"Our strike has had a strong response from workers but we have decided to renew our two-day stoppage next week in protest against the government's indifference to our claims," the Democratic Labour Confederation said in a statement.
The union says some 3,500 doctors and 40,000 paramedical staff work in the public sector. It was not clear whether all belonged to the union.

The medical workers started a 48-hours strike on Wednesday to press for a review of medical workers' status and compensation to cover professional risk, the union said. The union said at the end of the first day that support had ranged between 80 and 100 percent.
No one was immediately available at the health ministry to comment.
